snippet.title: Duck Side of the Moon - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Waddle and fly as a duck in space in Duck Side of the Moon, OUT NOW on PC and Nintendo Switch!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959770/Duck_Side_of_the_Moon/
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/duck-side-of-the-moon-switch/

Explore every corner of the galaxy, find curious creatures and materials, craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure!
